family: Qwen-Image-2.1 (7B DiT base; Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder; still images, 2048x2048 RGBA)
hardware: RTX 3070 8 GB, 64 GB DDR4, Windows 11, ComfyUI v0.37.4, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130

pipeline.quality_negative: TextEncodeQwenImage21 negative prompt (real negative; CFG 3.5 depends on it)
pipeline.fast_adapter: p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors (Pruna DMD), strength 1.0; not redistributed - adapter weights are not in the manifest and no FAST workflow ships, so this row is baseline research
pipeline.decode: VAEDecode untiled in the locked production config (the tiled premul path exists in the workflow but is not executed)
pipeline.upscale: 4x-UltraSharp on RGB, bicubic x4 on alpha, merged, lanczos to 2048x2048
pipeline.prompt_enhancer: installed but bypassed (measured 124 s through VRAM paging)
pipeline.refiner_branch: LatentTiledRefiner present in the workflow but unreachable in the locked config (SaveImageAdvanced reads the upscaled image directly). Wiring it active failed end-to-end verification on 2026-09-30: the run peaked at 7,811 MB, over the 7,392 MB usable ceiling, with ~1.8 GB ambient desktop VRAM, and the A/B measurement showed lower foreground sharpness (513 vs 453). Rewire SaveImageAdvanced to node 20 to enable the branch.

tiling_algebra.problem: refine a 128x128 latent in 2x2 windows without seams
tiling_algebra.closure: n*T - (n-1)*O = H with n=2, O=16, H=128 -> T=72, stride 56
tiling_algebra.why_not_64: T=64 closes only with zero overlap (seams) or a 3x3 grid (9 tiles, over budget)

turbo_draft.verdict: FAIL recorded against the target window
turbo_draft.label: N=3 warm (distinct seeds)

two_pass_2k.config: two-pass 2K shape; the quant in use for this retained benchmark run is not recorded in its JSON (the Q5_K_M pivot happened in the same session; the locked quality config uses Q5_K_M)
two_pass_2k.verdict: FAIL recorded against the target window; the memory ceiling held
two_pass_2k.label: N=2 warm

control_locked_40step_tiled.note: inherited single run used as control, not re-measured in the same session

quality_ab_single_runs.note: single run each on identical seeds; the CFG 3.5 + real-negative pivot rests on these three runs plus visual review

final_suite_fast_mode.checks: one recorded FAIL row: a uniform foreground-sharpness threshold fails on deliberately shallow-DOF and long-exposure scenes
final_suite_fast_mode.label: one run per image, one seed each

deviations.cfg_pivot: the initial design specified CFG 1.0 + res_multistep/beta/30; adopted euler/simple/40/CFG 3.5 with a real negative prompt
deviations.quant_pivot: the initial design specified Q4_K_M; adopted Q5_K_M after the detail investigation
deviations.refine_removed: pass-2 latent re-denoise removed; removing it raised foreground sharpness 513 vs 453
deviations.pe_bypassed: prompt enhancer bypassed (124 s per call through VRAM paging)
deviations.banned_flags: --gpu-only-unet and res_2m do not exist in the installed argparse; the launcher purges them

notes: Laplacian sharpness is scene-dependent; cross-image comparisons are informational, within-scene comparisons are the evidence
VRAM figures come from free-memory sampling via torch.cuda.mem_get_info; the 7,392 MB usable ceiling was never exceeded in any retained run
Peak device VRAM in later suite runs reached 6.5-7.0 GB in early runs recorded in the benchmark JSONs; the retained production runs stayed at or below 6.54 GB
The 4-reference image cap is an 8 GB workstation deployment constraint to manage cross-attention activation memory; Qwen officially supports up to 10 references

archive_run_id / lab_record_id identify immutable records in the non-redistributed laboratory archive (campaign-prefixed BENCH_YYYY-MM-DD_* ids; '+' joins multiple records; _sN is a section suffix). See docs/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md.
